elements: Omega est la sous-catégorie pas pleine
a) comme objets; functors factor through E
b) comme morphismes; injective natural transformations
Omega a des opérations disjoint union, product, composition
formulas for sum, product, and composition
observations: Blue page defines outlined Omega=End(E,E) as a non-full subcategory of the functor category, with finite values and injections on maps, and only objectwise injective natural transformations. Three operations: disjoint union, cartesian product and composition. First formula has a heavily inked plus/coproduct sign, explicitly doubtful.

audit.notes: Full-sheet second reading verifies outlined Omega, pas pleine!, both object conditions, morphism injectivity, script E versus ordinary E and the three operation formulas. Ambiguous overwritten plus/coproduct remains marked.
